task: Parse an AWS CloudFormation template and extract all resource logical IDs
solution_criteria: Function should take a CloudFormation JSON/YAML template as input and return a list of all logical resource IDs. Should handle both JSON and YAML formats.

task: Create an AWS IAM policy JSON that allows read-only access to all S3 buckets
solution_criteria: Valid IAM policy document with appropriate S3 read-only actions (s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket) for all resources. Must follow AWS policy syntax.

task: Write a regex pattern to validate AWS ARN (Amazon Resource Name) format
solution_criteria: Pattern should match valid ARNs (e.g., arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name) and reject invalid formats. Should handle common AWS services like EC2, S3, IAM, and RDS.
